thread:
maya: Noticed duplicated panel invites in ATS for the same interviewer this morning during a scheduling run.

 tom: ouch. any example payload?

 maya: minimal webhook that repros:

 ```
 POST /webhook/panel_create
 {
   "candidate_id": "C-7220",
   "slots": [{"tags": ["frontend", "ui"]}, {"tags": ["ui"]}]
 }
 ```

 maya: result: two invites to external_id user:U198 (matches both slots). Expected: dedupe by external_id.

 alejandro: which matching layer handled this? new tag-index or legacy?

 maya: tag-index. logs show two hits and scheduler flattened arrays without uniq.

 ops-bot: incident-created #3850012345 - duplicate-panel-invites (sev:low) by maya \t6 assigned sasha

 sasha: taking it. quick mitigation: post-process matched list with uniq(external_id) before invite API call. Will prefer slot with more tags if conflict.

 tom: include a unit test for tag-count preference and an e2e with the payload above. low-risk patch.

 sasha: will open PR with tests + small cleanup migration to cancel duplicates created in last 72h.

 maya: can we add telemetry panel_duplicate_matches_count and a single-alert threshold? helps detect regressions.

 sasha: yes, adding metric and a one-off admin job to revoke duplicates and email affected candidates.

 alejandro: also update matching docs to clarify dedupe semantics and roll out note.

 sasha: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ats/pull/491 \t6 contains dedupe, tests, metric, and cleanup plan. I'll canary tomorrow.

 maya: thanks! I'll run staging invites once deployed. :thumbsup: 

 sasha: thanks all. closing loop when canary is green.
